title: New US AI Policy Blueprint Prioritizes AI Acceleration Despite Child Safety Pressure
summary: New policy blueprint bowed to bipartisan pressure on child safety but still prioritized AI acceleration. Shows continued US government support for AI development alongside safety measures.

title: Google AI Rewriting Verge Headlines
summary: The Verge reports seeing their headlines being rewritten by Google AI. Raises questions about AI summarization and attribution in search results.

summary: NVIDIA published guide on fine-tuning embedding models for specific domains. Covers data preparation, training, and deployment workflow.

title: Pope's AI Advisor Calls Peter Thiel a Heretic
summary: Father Paolo Benanti, Papal AI advisor, wrote essay calling Peter Thiel a heretic over his Antichrist lectures in Rome. Essay headline asks if he should be burned at the stake.

title: AI-Generated Val Kilmer to Star in New Movie
summary: Val Kilmer's estate agreed to let an AI-generated facsimile appear in upcoming film "As Deep As The Grave". Kilmer died December 2025 and was too sick to shoot scenes.

title: Eight Initiatives Compete for "Human-Made" AI Labels
summary: BBC reports eight different initiatives trying to establish labels distinguishing human-made products from AI-generated ones. Experts say single standard needed to avoid consumer confusion.

title: Google Promotes "Vibe Design" with Stitch AI Updates
summary: Google announced updates to Stitch, its AI coding tool for UI design, encouraging users to "vibe design" with new voice capabilities.

title: Meta NYC Store Becomes Permanent Flagship
summary: Meta's Fifth Avenue store in Manhattan is no longer a pop-up. Now a permanent flagship location selling AI smart glasses and Meta Quest headsets.

title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3 Content Safety 4B
summary: Multimodal, multilingual content moderation model released on Hugging Face for AI safety applications.

title: Perplexity Releases Comet Browser on iOS
summary: Perplexity has released its Comet browser on iOS, expanding its AI-powered search experience to mobile devices.

title: Sony Trains "Protective AI" Against Studio Ghibli Infringement
summary: Sony's R&D division is training a Protective AI model on Studio Ghibli content to prevent AI from ripping off protected material. Model designed to eventually stop AI plagiarism.

title: WordPress.com Enables AI Agents to Write and Publish Posts
summary: WordPress.com now allows AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to draft and publish blog posts via MCP. Agent-written posts start as drafts for human review before publishing.
